steps.warmUp: Warm up first. Today goes higher and lower, so take your time with the siren.
steps.edges: Higher notes need more breath, not more push; lower ones need you to relax, not press down. If a note feels strained, skip it: it’ll come with time.
steps.fifth: Notes up to a fifth above or below your comfortable note.
steps.range: And now notes from your whole range, as on the Tuner page.
